recommendation.decisionRule: Call a winner when it has ≥30 results and ≥90% probability of the lowest cost per result (Bayesian). Below that it is 'leading' or 'too early', never a winner.
recommendation.killRule: Pause any ad that spends 2x the target cost with zero results, or runs >1.5x target cost after 3x target spend.
recommendation.structure: No test campaigns. Boost organic winners for 3-4 days each.
notes: At ~2500 INR per result, 5000 buys ~2 results a month: not enough to learn anything statistically. Use paid only to amplify posts that already won organically, and judge it on cost per landing-page click.
No results yet: these are scenarios, not forecasts. The plan switches to observed costs automatically after 10+ results.
